## Fischer et al. (2014), FeSi b20 BM3 at 300 K

Record: `fesi_b20_fischer_2014_bm3_1` · Model: `BM3`

**Outcome: Coefficient parity achieved.**

**Scope:** Comparison with the source parameterization.
**Comparison basis:** Every compared free coefficient meets both the recorded combined-two-sigma comparison and parameter-specific numerical similarity screen. Error conventions and fit qualifications remain applicable.

[Stored EOS coefficients and source](../material-summaries/fesi_b20.md#record-fesi_b20_fischer_2014_bm3_1)

### What this result establishes

**Separate source-review status:** primary\_source\_validated.
**Usage recommendation:** See the stored EOS qualifications; no recommendation is inferred here.

- Complete single-phase source rows with published fixed choices. Unweighted pressure residuals and residual-scaled refit errors are diagnostics: source weights, coefficient confidence and covariance are unspecified. Parity denotes the ledger's numerical/combined-error criterion, not recovery of the authors' regression covariance. The Fe-16Si entry checks the 66-row thermal stage; the independent script also refits its 32-row static stage. See the \[Fischer audit\](literature-reproductions/fischer-2014-fesi.md).
- This named numerical assessment alone does not establish author-workflow reproduction, physical accuracy or recommendation for use.

### Data and reconstruction method

- **Dataset identifiers:** fischer\_2014\_table\_s2\_pvt
- **Observations:** 27
- **Fit kind:** isothermal\_pv
- **Selection:** phase=B20; reference-T rows
- **Objective:** pressure\_residuals
- **Absolute sigma:** False
- **Free parameters:** K0; K0\_prime
- **Fixed parameters:** V0

Unspecified selections, weights, fixed values or error conventions remain unknown; they have not been inferred for this report.

### Curves, residuals and fit error

![Original/source and refitted curves with pressure residuals for fesi_b20_fischer_2014_bm3_1](figures/fesi_b20_fischer_2014_bm3_1-curves.svg#only-light)
![Original/source and refitted curves with pressure residuals for fesi_b20_fischer_2014_bm3_1](figures/fesi_b20_fischer_2014_bm3_1-curves-dark.svg#only-dark)

| Fit | Pressure RMS error (GPa) |
| --- | ---: |
| Original / source fit | 0.384 |
| Reconstruction / refit | 0.37 |

Both fits use the same 27 recovered audit input rows. Residual = P(model) − P(input), evaluated at each input volume and temperature (isothermal records use their reference temperature). RMS is an unweighted descriptive pressure error, not a parameter uncertainty or the optimizer's weighted/latent-coordinate objective.

**Volume coordinate:** b20\_volume\_a3. **Row selection:** phase=B20; reference-T rows.

Curves use full stored coefficients. For thermal data, separate isotherms are labelled; when there are more than five temperatures, the minimum, middle and maximum sampled temperatures are shown. Residuals include every selected row at its own temperature. Coordinate error bars appear only where the row reader can recover all widths; their meaning remains that of the source dataset (including digitization widths). Missing bars do not mean zero error. No uncertainty band is inferred.

| K0 | 192.2 | 1.6 | 189 | 3 | Free |
| K0\_prime | 5.03 | 0.17 | 5.2 | 0.3 | Free |

Display rounding: errors with leading digit 1 or 2 use two significant digits; other errors use one. Each parameter is rounded to the same decimal place as its error. Values without a positive reported error use at most six significant digits; this is a display limit, not an uncertainty estimate. Full precision is preserved in EOSMAT and the numerical ledger. Missing errors mean unknown, not zero. Parameter names and volume conventions follow the named audit; error widths do not imply a confidence convention.
